prompt: I'm thinking of a man whose first name is Hart. He acted in a miniseries (based on a historical novel about WW2 with three words in its title) by an author who also wrote a book about a kid with the last name of Bookbinder.
answer:
The man is **Hart Bochner**.

- He acted in the miniseries **_War and Remembrance_**, based on Herman Wouk’s World War II historical novel of the same three-word title.
- Herman Wouk also wrote **_The City Boy_**, whose young protagonist is **Herbie Bookbinder**.
